nodes.label: TandemPay App Icon
nodes.description: TandemPay mobile app icon featuring a bold 3D blue gradient chevron/caret shape (resembling an inverted 'V' or upward-pointing arrow legs) centered on a light blue background. The design uses construction guide lines (circles and crosshairs), suggesting a geometric, professionally-designed brand mark. The style is modern, glossy, and iOS-ready with a clean minimal aesthetic. The blue color palette and chevron motif convey forward motion and financial connectivity.
